summary: Full frontend re-test of the 60s LOKAGER Module 0 brand-film ceremony at https://lokager-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. ALL 11 requested scenarios PASS. 60s countdown timer decremented exactly one per second with zero skipped/duplicate numbers (measured sequence 59→0 captured; 60 was displayed only for the initial ~1s window before the first sample). All 20 scenes appeared in the correct order at ~3s intervals with correct lead ('LOK means'/'AGER means'/'Together,') on scenes 1-3, support text on scenes 1-17, and no support text on scenes 18-20. Desktop side panels (>=1024px) show one image/art visual + one chapter card; every unsplash image loaded (naturalWidth=720, no broken images, no 4xx responses). Celebration screen appeared at ~60.7s (60s + framer transition), showed eyebrow/wordmark/live/tagline/sub and gold-sweep. Coming-Soon screen appeared ~9s after celebration (matches CELEBRATION_MS=9000) and remained visible (URL unchanged /launch, no redirect). Reload resilience verified (timer 55→54 after reload). Gate works: after seen flag, / shows coming-soon directly; /launch (without startedAt) shows launch-button again. Responsive: no horizontal overflow on 1920, 1366, 820, 390; side panels visible only on >=1024, scene-visual-mobile visible on <1024; timer/message inside viewport and non-overlapping; mobile launch button height=76px (>=72). Zero console errors, zero /api calls from the frontend during the entire flow.

issues: Side panels remain in DOM with opacity=1 for scenes 19-20; visuals inside are type=none so nothing is rendered, which visually achieves the requested 'fade' effect but is not implemented as an opacity transition on the panels themselves. Consider transitioning side-panel-left/right opacity to 0 explicitly for scenes 19-20 for a smoother animated fade rather than an abrupt disappearance of the framed visual.

critical_code_review_comments: site.js: COUNTDOWN_MS=60000, ZERO_HOLD_MS=700, CELEBRATION_MS=9000, SCENE_COUNT=20 are all consistent with spec.
scenes.js: SCENE_VISUALS length is 20, matches SCENE_COUNT; scenes 19-20 use type='none' which correctly hides side visuals during the finale.
Timer text uses Math.ceil(remainingMs/1000) so display is 60 briefly on click then 59, 58,... 1, 0 — matches spec.
Reload resume: lokager_launch_started_at persists in localStorage; on reload the countdown continues from the correct elapsed time (verified 55→54 across a page.reload).
seed_data_creation: None. Only localStorage manipulation: lokager_launched_seen, lokager_launch_started_at (per spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full 60s ceremony end-to-end verified on desktop 1920x1000, laptop 1366x768, tablet 820x1180, mobile 390x844. Timer is Math.ceil of remaining seconds; celebration appears ~60.7s after click due to framer-motion exit transition; coming-soon appears exactly 9s after celebration. Use page.evaluate('localStorage.clear()') then localStorage.setItem('lokager_launch_started_at', String(Date.now()-N)) to seed mid-countdown positions and always allow ~1.5-2s settle after reload before reading DOM (framer-motion mount transition briefly shows the first scene state).

measured_timer_sequence.note: Sampled once per second starting ~1.5s after click; the value 60 was only shown transiently during the first ~1s window and was not captured.
measured_timer_sequence.celebration_appeared_at: ~60.7s from click (verified via seeded run: at Date.now()-60500 the celebration-screen was visible on reload)
measured_timer_sequence.coming_soon_appeared_at: ~9s after celebration (verified: coming-soon-container appeared after waiting 10.5s post celebration mount)

images_check: All elements inside scene visuals loaded (naturalWidth=720). No 4xx/5xx HTTP failures observed. Scenes 1,3,15,17,18 use SVG line-art (type='art') instead of images; scenes 19-20 use type='none' (no visual).
